item.label: threefold tuition fee for foreign students
item.quote: Threefold tuition fee: CHF 2190 / semester. The threefold tuition fee for foreign students will apply from the Autumn Semester 2025.
Tuition fees (exams included) and semester fees: CHF 580.- (per semester)
item.notes: Per-semester figure for Bachelor students as stated on the page. The page states no separate rate for foreign (non-Swiss) students, so this figure may not be international-specific; staff should confirm. Academic year not stated on the page.
